text.tspan: Read the named relationships first. Complete typed attributes appear on pages 2–3; repeated User labels denote the same entity.
Each contribution is its own event. One lender may contribute again to the same eligible request.
Only full funding activates a loan.
InstallmentNumber is unique only within its loan.
One payment can cover several installments;
one installment can receive several payments.
At most one active membership per pair.
Composite identifier maps to two PK columns.
Role ovals are notation, not a stored list.
Dashed oval = derived; underlined oval = key.
Double line: total participation · single: partial
(min,max) at an entity: its participation count
Page 2–3 FK cards state both directions explicitly.
All 15 entities and 114 attributes are defined there.
